conclusions: The persistent B01 R1024_T32 V02 target is an exact full-vector recurrence in the tested Reference-Richards Newton path.
For each preregistered pair 26/50, 27/51 and 32/56, all 1024 pressure-head bit patterns and all 1024 nonlinear-residual bit patterns are identical.
The matched B01 R2048_T32 V02 control converges at iteration 17 under unchanged tolerances.
The C6R Stage-1 blocker is therefore a Reference numerical-method issue in the tested interval, not evidence about Layer-ROM root-feedback state sufficiency.

handoff.required: Independent Reference numerical-policy authority before a new root-active Reference qualification may be attempted.
handoff.boundary: Any transfer to ROM-ROOT must be preregistered as a new Reference authority. It may not be described as a repair or relaxation of C6R.
